profile.headline: Senior Lead Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: Experienced Full-Stack Software Engineer with a strong background in designing and developing responsive frontends, scalable microservices, and robust data/business intelligence solutions. Holds a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Software Engineering & Computer Science from the University of Miami and a Master's in Computer Science with a Machine Learning Specialty from Georgia Tech. Well-versed in DevOps practices, demonstrating expertise in deploying to AWS using Kubernetes. Additionally, has expertise using Apache Airflow and holds a certification in Airflow Fundamentals from Astronomer. Passionate about utilizing technology to drive innovation and deliver high-quality solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Cloudhound Toolbox: Internal framework for managing and reporting on cloud spend, resource compliance, and provisioning
● Implemented a self-provisioning module that ​allowed developers to effectively provision their Amazon Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs)
● Developed a Compliance Dashboard, which was used by account owners to view non-compliant resources against cloud security
guardrails
● Worked with another engineer to integrate Cloudhound’s frontend with a Metastore RESTful API, which maintained metadata on
accounts, line of businesses, portfolios and other business entities
● Implemented monitoring solution to promptly alert support engineers to critical services failure, containers health, and instance
utilization via Slack and StatusPage
Leveraged Knowledge​: Full Stack Web Development, ​React JS, Scalable Microservices Architecture in Python (Flask microframework). Amazon Web Services: ​ECS, EC2, Cloudformation, RDS (Postgres), Lambda, S3, Neptune Graph Database, DynamoDB, Parameter Store, and CloudWatch Events and Alarms. Ansible AWX API, Terraform templates, Docker, Slack API, StatusPage API, Gremlin (graph traversal language) and TinkerPop API (graph computing framework)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned the Cloudhound framework, which was used internally for managing and reporting on cloud spend and resource management
Architected and developed Cloudhound’s frontend and backend as a microservices architecture using React JS, Python Flask microframework and various Amazon Web Services

positions.title: Associate Architect
positions.description:
Nielsen Connect: Report Viewer, business Intelligence framework leveraged by Retailers and Manufacturers
● Developed a Prompting RESTful API for querying Star Database Schemas, which was used by the Report Viewer frontend to display available products’ hierarchies and dimensions
● Collaborated with other engineers to implement a Reporting RESTful API, which aggregated product fact data with dimension and hierarchies to provide insightful user reports
● Implemented integrations with Connected System’s platform services to increase API security, data protection and segregation Leveraged Knowledge​: ​RESTful API design and Microservices Architecture: ​Java Spring Boot, Star Dimensional data marts design, Docker, Document-based database (MongoDB), Javascript, Scala, Angular 2+. ​Amazon Web Services: ​ECS, EC2, Lambda, S3, and ElastiCache

positions.description: Developed Android Applications with extensive usage of the Android Cellphones and Platform capabilities, such as sensors, locators, actuators, Google Maps, SQLite databases, fragments, etc.

projects.title: Cell Tower Discovery Android Application
projects.description:
Cell Tower Discovery is an Android Application that tracks, collects, and exports data about the cellular towers in the range of an Android device
The Application has a database, which holds large sets of data that can be managed and exported from any Android Phone 
Cell Tower Discovery 1.0 was published on Google Play (May 2015), refer to the URL provided for this project for more information
